title: On Representational and Functional Alignment of Training Data Attribution Methods for Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.19286v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Existing approaches to training data attribution derive influence estimates from different sources of information, including gradients, model-internal states, and surface-level similarity. However, comparisons between attribution methods remain incomplete, often relying on indirect evaluations through downstream task performance. In this work, we introduce a framework for directly comparing methods along three dimensions: functional alignment, which measures correlation between full attribution vectors; representational alignment, which captures structural similarity of the representations underlying attribution; and cross-method predictability, which evaluates agreement on local pairwise ranking decisions. We observe strong representational and moderate functional alignment within paradigms. Alignment across paradigms is low and task-dependent, yet stable across models. translated_title: 论语言模型训练数据归因方法的表征对齐与功能对齐
translated_abstract: 现有的训练数据归因方法从不同的信息来源推导影响估计，包括梯度、模型内部状态以及表层相似性。然而，归因方法之间的比较仍不完善，通常依赖于通过下游任务性能进行的间接评估。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个框架，用于在三个维度上直接比较各种方法：功能对齐，衡量完整归因向量之间的相关性；表征对齐，刻画归因所依赖的底层表征的结构相似性；以及跨方法可预测性，评估各方法在局部成对排序决策上的一致性。我们观察到，在同一范式内部存在强表征对齐和中等程度的功能对齐。跨范式的对齐程度较低且依赖于任务，但在不同模型之间保持稳定。我们的结果表明，所观察到的相似下游性能……
tldr: 该论文提出了从功能对齐、表征对齐和跨方法可预测性三个维度直接比较语言模型训练数据归因方法的评估框架，发现同一范式内方法高度对齐，而跨范式对齐较低但在不同模型间保持稳定。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a framework for directly comparing training data attribution methods along three dimensions—functional alignment, representational alignment, and cross-method predictability—finding strong alignment within paradigms, while cross-paradigm alignment is low yet stable across models.
